steps: The planar intent and existing event-audio starter options show exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

The same saved ordinary TXT is explicitly referenced and bound to two independent character instances with four literal action parameters each. Cancel writes nothing; review and Apply change a draft; ordinary Save persists each binding; reopening restores both identities and all parameter values.

script-zh-CN.label: Godot / 平面运动意图
script-zh-CN.description: 绑定到 controls 为 none 且未启用重力的角色实例。left_action、right_action、up_action、down_action 默认使用 ui_left、ui_right、ui_up、ui_down，动作须已注册；模板不创建按键映射。每次物理回调提交二维方向，下一项目步只采纳该角色首个请求，对角线统一归一化，未提交时归零。只提供运动意图，不直接修改位置或绕过碰撞；退出时停止处理。

script-en.label: Godot / Planar movement intent
script-en.description: Bind to a character with controls=none and no gravity. left_action, right_action, up_action and down_action default to ui_left, ui_right, ui_up and ui_down; actions must already be registered. This template does not create key mappings. Each physics callback submits a 2D direction; only the first request for this character is accepted for the next project step. Diagonal input is normalized, and a step without a submission uses zero input. The script provides intent only: it never changes positions directly or bypasses collision. Processing stops on exit.

script-ja.label: Godot / 平面移動意図
script-ja.description: controls が none で重力を使用しないキャラクターにバインドします。left_action、right_action、up_action、down_action の既定値は ui_left、ui_right、ui_up、ui_down で、アクションは登録済みである必要があります。このテンプレートはキー割り当てを作成しません。物理コールバックごとに2D方向を送り、次のプロジェクトステップでは同じキャラクターの最初の要求のみ採用します。斜め入力は正規化し、送信のないステップはゼロ入力になります。位置を直接変更したり衝突を迂回したりせず、移動意図だけを渡します。終了時に処理を停止します。

limitations: Real Chrome with HTTP editor and disposable author files. This smoke verifies authoring only; native planar movement is not verified by this browser test.
No installed Tauri, Android, Bevy, automatic physics-body creation, automatic binding, live parameter discovery or native execution is claimed.
